{"reason": "Added (high-confidence? edi-change) to the conjunction. 6 of 8 false-arbitration rows (e.g. pct=-0.428 conf=0.66; pct=0.224 conf=0.44; pct=-0.178 conf=0.61) fall below the 0.7 confidence threshold, so this gate directly attacks the 0.714 false-arbitration-rate while keeping pct>0.15/exposure>500000 unchanged to preserve recall >= 0.8.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
